title: Teaching Reconciliation Protocol
description: Teaching reconciliation protocol: Step 3a wakeup now auto-detects already-implemented teachings via 3-tier verification (filename in signals, teaching name in signals, verification files exist). Auto-copies to processed/ folder without confirmation. Eliminates false-positive 'new teachings' on every wakeup when hub teachings are already implemented locally.
rationale: Solves fundamental usability issue affecting all spokes: hub teachings are immutable (can't be moved), so filename-based detection was insufficient. This protocol enables copy-on-reconcile pattern that works with canonical hub structure. Affects all future wakeups across all spokes.
